rationale: The stock has been in a sustained two-day downtrend with price well below session VWAP ($40.46 vs $43.05), but the 5-min ATR is extremely compressed at $0.13, making it difficult to structure a trade with acceptable risk/reward — any stop placement is either too tight for noise or too wide relative to realistic targets.
